en: A black and white historical postcard showing a waterfront scene in Sundsvall, Sweden. The photo features the area called Fisktorget (the fish market square) along the Selångerån river, with several early 20th-century buildings, a marketplace, and a prominent church with a tall spire in the distance. The reverse side shows the typical layout for writing a message and address.
